slides.title: Who protects Ethiopia's aid workers?
slides.body: A humanitarian coordinator's warning in Addis Standard

slides.title: tonnes of food aid on a truck reportedly hit by drone strikes
slides.body: on Sept 20, bound for displaced families in Sheraro, northwestern Tigray. Who carried out the strike has not been established.

slides.title: humanitarian vehicles seized by armed groups in 2025-2026, at least
slides.body: Only 2 had been recovered, the UN Resident and Humanitarian Coordinator said on Sept 30.

slides.title: Killed while helping others
slides.body: ORDA staff member Mahelet Sitotaw Abera died in crossfire in North Wollo in June 2025. MSF says families of 3 staff killed in Tigray in 2021 still await an impartial investigation.

slides.title: aid workers killed worldwide in 2025
slides.body: according to UN humanitarian office OCHA, which warned that armed drones are changing the risks.

slides.title: What the author calls for
slides.body: Safe ways to report attacks, real funding for staff protection, support for families, and credible investigations.

slides.title: Protect aid workers so aid reaches civilians.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
